reason: It's in my own complex, has Wi-Fi and seats, so I'd try the Moro Latte or Moro Fizzy for a post and stay to study. But on my pay I can't do 3.50 every day, so it's maybe once a week after payday.
objection: Only 37 reviews and I've never seen anyone post it, and 3.50 to 4.00 for a drink is a real chunk of what I earn when the Turkish coffee next door is cheaper.
would_change_my_mind: A staff discount for people working in the complex or a cheaper study deal like a drink plus Wi-Fi hours would make me come several times a week instead of once.
